FC Torpedo-BelAZ Zhodino or FK Tarpeda-BelAZ Zhodzina is a Belarusian professional football club based in Zhodzina (Zhodino). They play in the Belarusian Premier League, the top division in Belarusian football. Their home stadium is Torpedo Stadium.
